Role Title: AWS Console Specialist

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging AWS Console Specialists to contribute to a dynamic customer project focused on cloud infrastructure and operations. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity is ideal for professionals who excel at managing AWS environments and enjoy demonstrating advanced workflows in collaborative settings.

Scope of Work

  1. Demonstrate and document hands-on AWS Console workflows involving EC2, S3, IAM, and VPC management.
  2. Provide real-world input on resource provisioning, monitoring, and troubleshooting within AWS cloud environments.
  3. Showcase best practices for securing AWS resources and administering permissions using IAM.
  4. Create and explain sample architectures leveraging core AWS services.
  5. Participate in knowledge sharing activities and provide clear, articulate feedback on cloud operations experiences.
  6. Utilize current authorized AWS access to perform workflow tasks in a controlled, approved environment for training purposes.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Extensive, recent hands-on experience working in the AWS Management Console across multiple services.
  2. Proficiency with EC2, S3, IAM, and VPC administration and monitoring.
  3. Familiarity with cloud security concepts and implementation within AWS environments.
  4. Strong verbal and written communication skills for clear documentation and knowledge sharing.
  5. Experience troubleshooting cloud infrastructure issues and optimizing cloud resource management.
  6. Comfortable demonstrating and explaining cloud workflows for technical education or platform improvement initiatives.
  7. Authorized and current access to an active AWS account for project participation.
